description.value: Doc Morgan's is an oceanfront pub and restaurant located at the Union Steamship Marina on Bowen Island, serving elevated West Coast comfort food with a focus on fresh local seafood — including oysters and fan-favourite fish and chips. It sits right at the ferry terminus, making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving on or departing from the island. Private dining and group bookings are available for larger riding groups.
